fact: The Royal Centre for Remote Sensing (CRTS), with the Ministry of Agriculture, has produced national composite drought index maps from satellite data monthly during growing seasons since 2003 and publishes monthly bulletins to end users, with irrigated-land mapping for summer 2024.
title: Bilan à mi-parcours de l'Agenda Space 2030 - Rapport du CRTS
publisher: Centre Royal de Télédétection Spatiale (CRTS), via UNOOSA
